archive.digest_authority: Hugging Face dataset tree API, LFS oid
archive.verification_policy: Verify the complete archive size and SHA-256 before parsing a private captured snapshot. No prefix, range, alternate revision, or mirror is accepted.

member_policy.feature_blocks: One or more of x_num.npy, x_cat.npy, x_bin.npy must be present. The exact present set is taken only from the fully hash-verified archive, and the local inventory must match it exactly.
member_policy.hash_authority: Member sizes and SHA-256 digests are derived from the verified immutable archive on every offline load, rather than trusting an editable acquisition receipt.
member_policy.inventory_status: Verified locally on 2026-09-25 from the complete pinned archive. The Churn members are info.json (79 bytes), x_num.npy (10000x7 float32), x_bin.npy (10000x3 float32), x_cat.npy (10000x1 Unicode), y.npy (10000 int64), and int32 train/val/test split arrays with 6400/1600/2000 rows. Exact extracted-member byte digests are recorded in the local run manifest and are derived from the verified archive by the loader.
member_policy.other_datasets: Payloads from other datasets are scanned under resource limits and discarded; only allowlisted Churn payloads are published.
member_policy.manual_placement: Requires the same canonical archive retained locally and exact member equality; an extracted directory alone is insufficient.

split_policy: Preserve all source index values and their order. Require int32, unique, nonempty, pairwise-disjoint indices with complete 10000-row coverage. No regeneration or resplitting.

target.positive_class_semantic_meaning: Unconfirmed by T52; retain source binary encoding without remapping.

preprocessing.numeric: Finite values or NaN; train median imputation followed by QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=min(1000,n_train), subsample=n_train, random_state=0). No injected noise.
preprocessing.categorical: Train most-frequent imputation, ascending typed value tie-breaking, then dense float32 OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', drop=None). Missing means None or floating NaN; empty strings and literal 'nan' remain categories.
preprocessing.binary: Explicit x_bin columns must contain 0/1/NaN and join categorical preprocessing. No all-split binary discovery in x_num.
preprocessing.all_missing_train_columns: Fail closed; never impute from holdouts or silently drop columns.
preprocessing.output: Contiguous finite float32; original numeric block then categorical one-hot blocks; retained row IDs remain outside model features.
preprocessing.identity: Learned-state SHA-256 covers medians, complete quantile/reference arrays, modes, vocabulary, category block offsets, feature names, effective configuration, and dependency versions. It excludes held-out features, labels, and dataset identity.

security_limits.path_policy: Reject traversal, absolute paths, Windows drives/devices/reparse points, alternate separators and streams, trailing dot/space aliases, control characters, duplicate/case-colliding names, and file-directory collisions.
